_comment: GUP superset ledger — maps every legacy baseline artifact to its suite destination. modes: promoted (BETA became canonical), merged (hand-merge base), carried (verbatim + header normalization), absorbed (feature set lives inside dest), retired (kept only in legacy archive). evidence = human-readable superset argument.

autopage.json.note: WO-01 round-2 (6-b F6): 251 KB of autopager site rules carried from the legacy baseline — zero in-repo consumers by design (the readers are external userscripts that fetch this file from the raw repo URL, the WildFire-style autopager family). LEDGERED rather than retired precisely because retirement would break out-of-repo consumers; the file is inert data on every code census surface (no code, no grants, no matches). Reviewed each round with the rest of the ledger.
